headline: Public hearings on a sign permit at 260 Merrimack St and a re-petition for 9 Osgood Street.
summary: Osgood Street Partners asks for permission to refile a special permit for 9 Osgood Street that was denied on September 2nd 2026. A continued case for 539-557 Common St is also listed.
items: Continued case for 539-557 Common St (lots 145-0-15, 145-0-16, and 145-0-7), applicant AYJ Common St LLC
Special permit for 260 Merrimack St to replace an internally illuminated sign for MGB Urgent Care, petition by Metro Sign
Request for consent to refile a special permit at 9 Osgood Street, applicant Osgood Street Partners LLC, after denial on September 2nd 2026
plain_text:
LAWRENCE PLANNING BOARD 
PUBLIC HEARING 
 
Wednesday, December 02, 2026 at 6:00 PM 
255 Essex Street, Lawrence, MA 01840 
 
Continued Case 
 
539-557 Common St (lots 145-0-15, 145-0-16, & 145-0-7)  
AYJ Common St LLC LLC 
 
New Business
 260 Merrimack St- located in a I-2 Industrial Zoning District. Petition of Metro Sign of 170 
Lorum St, Tewksbury MA, for a special permit pursuant to section 29-11 in accordance 
with 29-20 (c)(3)(iii) of the Revised Zoning Ordinance of the City of Lawrence for the 
purposes of replacing and existing internally illuminated sign for a MGB Urgent Care.  
 
 Notice is hereby given pursuant to Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 40A, Section 16, and 
Section 11, that the City of Lawrence Planning Board will hold a public proceeding on the above 
date, time, and location. 
 
The Board will consider a request for Consent for a Repetitive Petition under M.G.L. c. 40A, § 16 
submitted by: 
 
 Petitioner / Applicant: Osgood Street Partners LLC, 9 Osgood Street, Lawrence, MA 01843 
 Regarding Property Location: 9 Osgood Street, Lawrence, MA 01843 
 Zoning District: I-2 Industrial Business Zone 
 Relief Requested: The applicant is requesting the consent of the Planning Board to allow a 
re-petition to the Lawrence Planning Board for a Special Permit that was previously denied 
on September 2nd 2026. The applicant asserts that specific and material changes in the 
conditions and design of the project have occurred to warrant consideration prior to the 
expiration of the statutory two-year moratorium under M.G.L. c. 40A, § 16. 
 
A copy of the application, revised plans, and statement of specific and material changes are on file 
and available for public inspection at the Office of the Planning Board or the City Clerk, City Hall, 
200 Common Street, Lawrence, MA, during regular business hours.
